title: Chernobyl dogs rapidly evolved

tellings.quote: there's a study that came out, or not even a study, an article that came out like this month, I think, about these dogs at Chernobyl that have rapidly evolved more than any other dog.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions an article he says came out recently about dogs living at Chernobyl, the site of a nuclear disaster. According to Michels, those dogs have evolved faster than any other dogs. He raises it as a hint that life can change quickly under unusual conditions.
